data.title: Voice Biometric Confidence Score Anomaly for Known Caller
data.description: Detects when a voice biometric verification score for a previously enrolled caller falls below an acceptable confidence threshold, which may indicate a deepfake or voice-clone attempt impersonating a legitimate customer. Legitimate callers typically produce scores above 85; scores between 40-70 with a previously stable voiceprint warrant investigation.

enrichment_required.source: Behavioral baseline enrichment (rolling average from analytics platform)
Voice biometric engine scoring (real-time voice verification)

falsepositives: Caller with a cold, sore throat, or other temporary vocal condition
Poor telephone line quality or high background noise environment
Caller using a different handset or headset than during enrollment
